  WHY: Operators may be misled about whether the label selects the engine after this change.
- workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:28 | severity=high | confidence=[5]

  PROBLEM: The note says engine-label plumbing is pending and the label is inert, although this PR implements the plumbing.
  WHY: Operators in consumer repositories may be misled about whether the label selects the engine after this change.
- .claude/commands/implement-plan-claude.md: line 12 (Step 3 fallback path) | severity=high | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The fallback path dispatches before adding the engine label to the tracking issue, allowing the orchestrator to create unlabeled wave-1 issues.
  WHY: Those issues may run using each role's default engine, and adding the label to the tracking issue afterward does not retroactively change them.
- tests/test_engine_label_propagation.py: lines 100-110 (`test_every_poller_issue_and_pr_creation_inherits_the_label`) | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The test does not verify that `TRACKING_LABELS` is refreshed for each poller issue or PR creation site.
  WHY: A creation path reached after a tracking-issue label change but before a refresh may omit the engine label, and the test would not detect it.
- .github/ai/label_contract.v1.json: lines 263-270 (`retired_labels` array) | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Retiring `ai:permission-prompt` can cause the next consumer sync to remove that label from consumer repositories.
  WHY: Operators may lose the label-based filter for open issues carrying it.
- workflow-templates/retired_files.txt: lines 17-22 (the retired-file manifest) | severity=low | confidence=[2]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: Hash-based retired-file handling silently skips a consumer's locally modified retired file, and the cited test does not cover that divergence.
  WHY: A consumer may continue running the old file after sync without the divergence being flagged.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate.yml: The decomposer attempt loop at lines 737–752 runs before engine-input validation in “Ensure orchestrator labels exist” at lines 993–1009. | severity=low | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: An invalid `engine` input is rejected only after the Codex decomposer has run.
  WHY: An unsupported engine value can incur up to three decomposer attempts, each with a 3000-second timeout, before the workflow reports the invalid input.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===

- requirement: Resolve the acknowledged 11 failures in `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py` so the required CI checks pass.
  expected_change_site: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` or `tests/test_gh_api_write_guard.py`; the template hook also has the reported ordering defect at `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py:1513-1517`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: `.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` checks `_unquoted_gh_api_expansion` before `_is_approvable_read_loop`; `workflow-templates/.claude/hooks/gh_api_write_guard.py` has the same ordering; the PR diff leaves the disagreement unfixed and the `tests-hooks-and-orchestrator` check fails.
- requirement: Remove or update the stale note that says engine-label plumbing is pending and the label is inert; this PR implements Phase 6.
  expected_change_site: `.claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:28` and `workflow-templates/.claude/commands/implement-issue-claude.md:28`
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [deepseek_deepseek-v4-pro, google_gemini-3_8-flash, z-ai_glm-5_2]
  EVIDENCE: Both command copies still state that the label is recorded but inert; `implement-plan-claude.md` was updated for the new dispatch path, but `implement-issue-claude.md` was not.
- requirement: “It makes the `ai:engine-claude` / `ai:codex` label reach every role of a project, so a whole project runs on one engine.”
  expected_change_site: Production role call sites that select the engine, including `.github/workflows/orchestrate.yml` and scheduled poller roles.
  confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  EVIDENCE: `scripts/claude_engine.py` reads labels from `issue` or `pull_request` event payloads, but `workflow_call` payloads have neither; `ai_engine_for_role` has no production callers; the orchestrator decomposer invokes `codex` directly before the later engine-label mapping; no role workflow sets `AI_ENGINE_LABELS`.
=== END CONSENSUS TASK GAPS ===
